# Fripse AI

> Fripse AI is a Utah-based AI business assessment and workflow automation consultancy. It works with small businesses, professional services firms, home-service companies, and field-based teams in Utah and remotely.

## What Fripse AI does

Fripse starts with a business assessment: interviews and workflow mapping to identify repetitive work, bottlenecks, communication gaps, and practical automation opportunities. The result is a prioritized roadmap. Implementation and team training are available after the assessment.

## Services

- **2 Hour AI Business Checkup**: A focused working session for owners and small teams. It identifies three to five practical opportunities to reduce repetitive work.
- **1 Day AI Deep Dive**: A full-day workflow assessment for teams of roughly five to fifteen people. It produces a prioritized AI playbook, workflow maps, and implementation guidance.
- **AI workflow automation**: Automation for recurring administrative work, follow-up, scheduling, client communication, reporting, and connected business tools.
- **AI readiness quiz**: A short self-assessment for business owners who want a starting point.

## Who it is for

Fripse AI works with small businesses that rely on scattered text threads, spreadsheets, repeatable administrative work, or disconnected business tools. Common audiences include contractors, home-service companies, professional services firms, and other service businesses.

## Founder

Fripse AI was founded by Dustin Crump.

## Important notes

- Fripse AI does not promise specific rankings, citations, recommendations, cost savings, or revenue results.
- Any automation scope is determined after reviewing the business workflow and its systems.
- Public site forms are for contact requests and require an explicit visitor submission.
